findings.message: The circuit demands 24.2 mm of cylinder stroke against a 10.0 mm limit. The piston bottoms before the brakes are fully applied -- this is a pedal that goes to the floor, not a soft one.
154.4 mm of travel at the pad against 30.0 mm available. Go after the largest consumers first: Piston knockback / running clearance, Pad compression.

Knockback, pad compression, hose and caliper compliance are representative values, not measured on this car. The RANKING of consumers and the sensitivity to bore and ratio are trustworthy; the absolute travel is provisional. One bench measurement -- pump to a firm pedal, measure the travel -- fixes that via TravelParams.from_measured_stroke().
